Name: Once Upon A Fleurine- Nyapu Flavored
Author: Blossom5280
Description:
[center][size=3]So ya girl absolutely fell in love with Fleurine from Once Upon a Fleurine!
[/size]
[size=3]
But Cause i also love nyapu's portraits too much? i had two choices:

[i][b]A. Ignore the mismatching portrait styles

B. Get some matching portraits made
[/b][/i]
This mod is the result of Option B :3

Shout out to the users of the Stardew Valley Discord! Including but not limited to:

Tottlesfarm for allowing me to make portraits of her npc and providing info for how she's supposed to look!
Nyapu for creating their amazing portraits! I used Haley's portrait as a base since Tottlesfarm did mention that their portraits do look closest to haley
Abagaianye for teaching me to code and helping with feedback
ParcySnippet for feedback! specifically for how to add the freckles
atelier99 for feedback! specifically for how to properly color her hair
Bezajel for helping with the code and config setup cause i gotta be extra and couldn't choose between the hairstyles


[u]Requirements:[/u]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25349]Nyapu's Portraits Inspired by Dong (optional but recommended!)[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33082]Once Upon a Fleurine[/url]﻿
     [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher ﻿[/url]﻿

[u]Install Instructions:
[/u][/size][size=3]
1.Install the above required mods

2. Install this mod and drop it in your mod folder

3. profit nyapu style :3

Uninstall Instructions:

Remove the mod! it'll revert back to the original!

[s]let me know if ya like the strawberry blond variant and i might include a config to switch between em ;3
[/s]Cause i had to be extra it now includes a config to allow for either or!

In the event there are more outfits and/or updates come along for the original mod? best believe i'll add compatibility for it!

[url=https://discord.gg/stardewvalley]Again thank you to the people who directly helped me and the Stardew Valley Discord Server![/url]﻿
